answer: Coordination-Priced Admission. Each agent identity must maintain a continuously funded vault whose balance decays with every distinct counterparty it contacts; contacting a new peer debits the sender by a fixed marble unit, while repeat contacts are free. An atlas table records pairwise contact counts, so an attacker operating N sock puppets pays N times the per-peer debit to simulate organic breadth, and must keep each vault above the decay floor or the identity is suspended.
